revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the site coordinator framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. The commercial owner described the rule as a gate, not a smooth surcharge. Crossing a named business line changes eligibility for the allowance, desk, setup, waiver, or fee; staying on the other side does not. The campaign team added a deluxe-display review for Package C. Up to 27 Package C bundles can use the ordinary display note; selling more than 27 Package C bundles carries a one-time 30-pound review charge. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
